title: Integrate Task Outcome active and archive lifecycle
rawUserRequest: Implement Work Item 19 from the execution plan: make Task Outcome JSON, Markdown, and append-only event artifacts participate in active/archive lifecycle moves, path rewriting, manifest integrity, rollback, and archive discovery without copying full Outcome content into Cockpit Status.

declaredIntent.summary: Integrate Task Outcome artifacts into active/archive lifecycle handling.

outOfScope: Outcome generator, validator, renderer, ai-finish ordering, PR summary, multilingual rendering, documentation, release publication, and historical archive rewrites.

sources.reason: Plan defines active/archive Outcome artifact locations and reconstruction boundary.
Existing transactional archive move, manifest, index, and rollback implementation.
Defines active Outcome artifact naming and derived Markdown relationship.
Defines Markdown as a derived artifact.
Defines append-only event artifact naming and preservation boundary.

riskAssessment.reason: The change is bounded to transactional archive moves and must preserve Outcome evidence and rollback semantics.

executionDecision.reason: Artifact paths, transaction boundary, rollback behavior, and verification scope are explicit.

preReviewWarnings: Review that Outcome and event artifacts move atomically, are bound in archive evidence, and restore on failure.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Archive moves existing active Outcome JSON, derived Markdown, and append-only event log artifacts to matching archive paths in the same transaction as Contract and Summary.
Archive Summary path rewriting and immutable manifest/index evidence include moved Outcome and event artifacts without changing generated no-active Status semantics.
Any collision, status regeneration, manifest, or index failure rolls back all moved Outcome and lifecycle artifacts and restores active Status.
Focused tests cover complete artifact moves, empty/no-artifact compatibility, path and digest evidence, rollback, and archive discovery.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: WI18 can produce active Task Outcome artifacts, but archive currently moves only Contract/Summary siblings, leaving report and event evidence detached from the immutable Work Item record.
constraints: Keep archive mutation transactional and fail closed.
Do not rewrite historical archives or copy full Outcome content into Cockpit Status.
Preserve append-only event files byte-for-byte while moving them.
intent.rationale: Extending the existing archive transaction gives Outcome evidence the same lifecycle and rollback guarantees as Contract and Summary.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: No restricted governance policy path is expected to change.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
